title: Battle of Kosovo (1448)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Kosovo (1448)", at revision 1377295199, opens: "The Second Battle of Kosovo was a land battle between a Hungarian-led Crusader army and the Ottoman Empire at Kosovo field that took place from 17–20 October 1448. It was the culmination of a Hungarian offensive to avenge the defeat at the Battle of Varna four years earlier. In the three-day battle the Ottoman army under the command of Sultan Murad II defeated the Crusader army of regent John Hunyadi." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q698706, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1448 battle between Hungarian-led Crusaders and the Ottoman Empire". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
